# Third-party source inventory

This directory contains vendored source or reproducibly generated local
installations that are part of the native AYTHER build. Project code remains
MPL-2.0; every component below retains its own terms.

| Component | Upstream revision | Integration | License material |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ymfm` | `81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a` (2026-07-27) | Nine vendored C++ translation units in `ayther::ymfm`; installed as `Ayther::ymfm` | `ymfm/LICENSE` and `ymfm/README.md` |
| `libvpx` | tag `v1.15.2` | Optional Windows VP9-only static decoder generated by `tools/build_libvpx.ps1`; build-tree target `ayther::vpx`, installed target `Ayther::vpx` | Generated installation includes `VERSION`, `LICENSE`, `PATENTS`, and `AUTHORS` |

The vendored ymfm files were compared byte-for-byte with the upstream commit
above when this inventory was recorded. Update the commit, source files, and
license material in one change.

`third_party/libvpx/`, `third_party/src/`, and `third_party/build-*` are local
generated directories and are ignored by Git. The libvpx script clones the
pinned tag, disables VP8, the VP9 encoder, tools, examples, documentation, unit
tests, WebM I/O, and shared libraries, then builds `vpxmd.lib` without LTCG for
compatibility with `lld-link`. Use `-Clean` after moving the checkout or
changing the tag.

Dependencies managed by vcpkg are declared in the root `vcpkg.json`, whose
`builtin-baseline` pins their port revisions. Native CMake presets select the
`renderer` feature; installed SDKs copy each selected port's `copyright` file
under `share/licenses/Ayther/vcpkg/`.

`cores/core.lock` is a runtime-fixture lock, not a build dependency or bundled
redistributable. It records the expected libretro release, filenames, build ID,
and SHA-256 hashes used by integration oracles. Core binaries remain ignored,
are not installed by CMake, and must only be obtained and distributed when the
operator has the necessary rights.
